verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official developer tooling: Salesforce promotes its APIs, ships an official npm-installed CLI with a plugin developer guide, and publishes an official MCP server. A community comment also credits Salesforce with VS Code extensions and local Lightning Web Components development. However, no evidence names an official language SDK or client library for building against Sales Cloud, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs/client libraries, a published machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on confirmation of SDK-based builds.
